methods.name: Heuristic schedulers
methods.description: Five non-learning rules that pick the next request by a fixed priority.

methods.name: Plain Maskable PPO
methods.description: Maskable PPO policy over feasible requests, without bee-inspired features.

methods.name: Fixed-threshold BEE
methods.description: Maskable PPO with a bee-inspired mask that filters requests whose activation falls below a fixed threshold.

methods.name: Adaptive-threshold BEE (A6)
methods.description: BEE with a threshold that moves with scarcity, contention and unmet pressure, gated to adapt only when at least two pressure indicators fire.

methods.name: Adaptive BEE first pass (A3)
methods.description: Earlier selected adaptive rule, superseded by A6 after the declared tie-break; shown for the A3 vs A6 comparison only.
